newsitem.title: USA: Penn-America cleared to form auto insurance unit.
newsitem.headline: Penn-America cleared to form auto insurance unit.

text.p: Penn-America Group Inc said the Pennsylvania insurance commissioner granted its Penn-America Insurance Co unit charter approval to form the Penn-Star Insurance Co.

The new subsidiary will manage and expand Penn-America's growing non-standard personal automobile insurance programs, which currently represent annual gross written premiums of $22 million, 28 percent of the company's 1996 overall annual premium volume.
The new company will be capitalized with a $15 million contribution by the parent company, Penn-America Insurance Co.
Penn-America will appoint a president of the new subsidiary in the near future. Thursday, 6 March 1997 16:38:50
